planPhases.title: Add updateUser action to AuthContext
planPhases.notes: Added `updateUser(user: User): void` to AuthContextValue interface and implemented it in AuthProvider — calls setUser(updatedUser) and localStorage.setItem('auth_user', JSON.stringify(updatedUser)). Pre-existing test/build failures exist (protectedRoute.test and missing ProfilePage) and are unrelated to this change.

planPhases.title: Create ProfilePage component
planPhases.notes: Created src/benchmark-frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx with view/edit modes, change-password section, diff-based PATCH body, 409/400 error handling, and success flow. All 8 profilePage tests pass. The pre-existing protectedRoute test failure is unrelated. Build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Wire /profile route in App.tsx with ProtectedRoute
planPhases.notes: Added ProtectedRoute and ProfilePage imports to App.tsx; added <Route path='profile' element={<ProtectedRoute><ProfilePage /></ProtectedRoute>} /> inside the AppLayout block. Also fixed a pre-existing ProtectedRoute test failure: AuthContext was initializing token/user from localStorage in a useEffect (async), causing isAuthenticated to be false on first render. Changed to lazy useState initializers so the state is read synchronously. All 42 tests pass; build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Run all frontend tests and fix any failures
planPhases.notes: Ran `pnpm test` from src/benchmark-frontend. All 42 tests across 12 test files passed (protectedRoute, profilePage, authLogin, authSignup, authNavBar, filtering, sorting, pagination, clearFilters, loadingError, app.render, authProductsApiToken). Build also succeeded with no errors.
